messages:
From: SkyForge Billing <accounts@skyforge.ai>

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected VAT on June invoice + split line-items showing test env usage

Hi Rafael,

Hope you27re well. We received Invoice INV-2027-06-2718 yesterday and noticed an unexpected VAT line (EUR 4,320) and that several overage line-items appear attributed to our production entity rather than the sandbox/test project. The accounting team needs a VAT breakdown by legal entity and confirmation whether we should self-account (reverse charge) or whether Redwood charged VAT on your side.

Specific asks:
- Can you send a per-project/per-API-key usage export for Jun 15-30 (tokens and session counts)?
- Please confirm which legal entity this invoice was issued to (we have multiple subsidiaries).
- If the overage lines are misattributed, please propose an adjustment/credit and timeline.

We27ve put the invoice on hold for payment pending clarification. Attaching a copy of the PDF we received (invoice_JUN2027.pdf).

Thanks,

Olivia Chen
Head of Finance Operations
SkyForge AI
accounts@skyforge.ai

2) Marissa will confirm the billed legal entity on INV-2027-06-2718 and validate VAT treatment.

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2027 09:37:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Unexpected VAT on June invoice + split line-items showing test env usage

Hi Olivia / Rafael,

Thanks for the ticket. I pulled the export and Ben provided the per-key breakdown — attaching usage_export_0615-0630.csv (partial) and a draft credit note for review. High-level findings:

- Attribution root cause: During a key rotation on 2027-06-20 one of your sandbox API keys was re-registered without the sandbox project tag; our attribution service then attributed calls from that key to the default (production) legal entity for the period 2027-06-20 02:14 UTC -> 2027-06-27 17:03 UTC.
- Impact: ~1.2M additional tokens billed to the production entity (line items INV-LN-07/09/12). Gross overage = EUR 2,760.
- VAT: The invoice was generated including VAT because the billing profile on file did not have an EU VAT ID for the production legal entity. If you can provide your EU VAT ID and confirm the entity that should be billed, we can zero-rate the corrected invoice under reverse charge rules where applicable.

Proposed remediation:
1) Issue a credit note for EUR 2,760 against INV-2027-06-2718 and reissue a corrected invoice split across the two legal entities (production vs sandbox). Draft credit_note_draft.pdf attached.
2) If you provide the EU VAT ID for the impacted entity by EOD Mon (12 Jul), we can reissue with reverse charge and remove the EUR 4,320 VAT line.
3) Timeline: approved credit + VAT info -> corrected invoice within 5 business days; immediate application of credit to your account balance so payment hold can be partially released.

Next steps for you (Olivia): share the exact legal entity and VAT number, and confirm whether SkyForge wants a single consolidated invoice after correction or separate invoices per legal entity.

Ben, please confirm the exact file with token-level rows and mark sandbox sessions so I can include the stamping in the credit note.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance (Billing)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: usage_export_0615-0630.csv, credit_note_draft.pdf

Thanks Marissa, Rafael — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Good news: our accounting confirms the EU VAT ID for the impacted production entity as GB999999973 (please use full registered name: SkyForge AI Ltd, 12 Bridge St, London, UK). We27d prefer separate invoices per legal entity so our AP can process them against the correct ledgers.

Two quick asks before you reissue:
- Can you provide a proforma (PDF) showing the corrected amounts and VAT treatment so I can run it by our AR team before re-opening payment?
- Can you apply the proposed credit to the outstanding balance immediately (even if the corrected invoice is issued later)? That will allow us to release the remainder of the payment.

If you can send the proforma and confirm the credit application timing, I27ll escalate internally and aim to clear the balance within 3 business days of receiving the corrected paperwork.
